en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a grand historicist theatre building with a domed roof, ornate façade, columns, statues and a fountain in front. It is situated on a street corner with multi‑storey residential blocks and a tree‑lined area opposite. Early motor vehicles and pedestrians appear on the street. Handwritten notes are visible across the image and near the bottom. Printed caption at the bottom reads the city district and the name of the theatre and adjoining street in German.
